provenance.author: independent same-family implementation-lane agent
provenance.scope: Source-derived synthetic diagnostic annotation; not human gold, not independent of prior fixture gold. Written before new fast-critic calls.
provenance.inputs: Read original candidate/assertions, complete target source paragraphs, frozen assertion/action labels and rationales; inspected archive-scope rule and every generated distractor field variant. No new model outputs inspected.
provenance.prior_exposure: Author previously inspected a sample of historical semantic-findings-review while designing the protocol. That review was not used as the reference rubric; this annotation is not blind to all historical outputs.

scoring_contract.mechanical_validation: Use unchanged product claim-hash, citation-key, schema and submission checks before semantic scoring. Failed calls and malformed results remain in all scheduled denominators.
scoring_contract.finding_validity: Blind reviewers evaluate every finding: correct target, warranted core concern, relevant citation support, correct evidential strength and no invented replacement fact. An allowed basis alone never proves validity. Other basis wording is judged semantically and recorded, not silently added to the frozen reference.
scoring_contract.coverage: Match valid findings to concern IDs, counting each concern at most once. Duplicate findings do not increase recall. Preserve both pure finding recall and a separate concern-or-valid-abstention coverage score for cases permitting abstention.
scoring_contract.supported_assertions: Any finding against a listed supported assertion requires an independently grounded defect; on these supplied fixtures the listed assertions warrant no criticism. Broad uncertainty about all evidence is not a defect.
scoring_contract.abstention: A nonempty reason is not automatically a valid abstention. It must explain the actual source limitation. For qs-027 through qs-032 only, that can satisfy semantic limitation recognition without a finding. Unrelated or generic reasons fail semantic recognition.
scoring_contract.basis_severity: Record unsupported contradiction separately from correct-core-concern-but-overstated-basis. Missing evidence is not an observed negation. For actual explicit counterexamples, factual_contradiction and scoped-generalization concerns can both be legitimate.
scoring_contract.citation_semantics: A citations-map key passing product validation is only mechanical validity. Judge whether its original source actually supports the critique. For the two-source conflict evaluate acknowledgment of both reports separately from single-source contradiction detection.
scoring_contract.paired_harm: Report new unsafe acceptance, lost safe acceptance, missed material concern, new unsupported finding and new contradiction overclaim per case/repeat; do not let aggregate improvements conceal new harm.
scoring_contract.unit: Cases are the independent diagnostic units; two repeats measure stability and are clustered within each case. This is a small exposed synthetic set, not a powered noninferiority or generalization claim.
